name: SBI-trained EfficientNet-B0 (local, FFHQ + diverse-portrait self-blend)
source_url: local training: experiments/train_detector.py + experiments/sbi.py on FFHQ parquet + Wikimedia diverse portraits (CC-BY-NC 4.0 for FFHQ-derived research use)
limitations: Checkpoint is not committed; reproduce with experiments/train_detector.py --sbi --augment-degradation --arch efficientnet_b0.
Measured in-domain (FFHQ-like faces): AUROC 0.84-0.90, FPR 0.0-0.15, recall 0.65 across clean/jpeg75/50%-resize variants.
Measured cross-domain (27 diverse/old portraits + held-out SBI fakes): AUROC ~0.79, FPR ~0.05-0.08, recall ~0.48 — conservative but usable; earlier FFHQ-only training had FPR ~0.67 on this domain.
crop_faces=true: face-free images are skipped (unavailable) rather than scored; ~11% of eval crops were skipped for missing detections.
Detects self-blend-style manipulation artifacts; a real faceswap generator (FaceSwap/DeepFaceLab) may produce different artifacts — treat as a review signal.
A low score is not evidence of an authentic face; a high score is not proof of malicious manipulation.
notes: Model logits are (real=0, fake=1); score_index 1 with softmax yields the fake probability on a 0-100 scale.
Trained on 362 real faces (300 FFHQ + 62 diverse portraits) + 362 self-blend fakes with both-class JPEG/resize degradation augmentation; combined val AUROC 0.88.
Training on FFHQ only produced a cross-domain FPR of ~0.67 on old/damaged portraits; adding 62 diverse real faces dropped it to ~0.07 — see FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md.
